# Audience width

**How wide or narrow is the audience the hook calls out?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C19


## Widen one layer
<a id="one-layer-up"></a>

Raise the audience one level for reach ('PC builders' becomes 'anyone with a laptop') and drop narrowing words.

**Looks like:** Not 'RTX owners, do this' but 'Your laptop is wasting battery because of one setting.' Anyone can relate in the first second.

**Good at:** non-follower reach; shares; universal topics travel furthest (Rahul's Gmail reel)

**Weak at:** ghost followers who don't care about the core niche; lower like rate

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals reach, shares · effort low

**How:** Rewrite the hook without niche words, then test it on a non-niche friend.

**Backed by:** [Widen the audience one layer higher](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-high-tam-one-layer-up), [Universal tricks reach, niche builds engage](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-universal-vs-niche-reach), [Make it concrete and visual](../topics/text.md#text-zoom-in-concrete), [Context in the first words, three channels](../topics/hooks.md#hook-context-first-words), [Withhold the rest: "comment for the rest"](../topics/growth.md#growth-withheld-remainder) · sources L08, R1

## Hyper-specific or hyper-local
<a id="hyper-specific"></a>

Call out an exact place, moment or person: 'If you're going to Nehru Place this weekend...'.

**Looks like:** Road-sign graphics with real market names. The hook names the exact situation, and the right viewer feels it was made for them.

**Good at:** loyal engagement; comments; can't be copied; local search

**Weak at:** smaller pool; outsiders skip

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, carousel · niches all · goals comments, trust, follows · effort low

**How:** Name the exact place in the hook, the on-screen text, the caption and the location tag.

**Backed by:** [Hyper-local conditional hook](../topics/hooks.md#hook-hyper-local-conditional), [AI prompt: unique, specific, observed](../topics/ai-tools.md#ideas-unique-specific-observed), [Name the exact spot everywhere](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-place-specific-seo), [Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook), [Contrast hook: looks X, sounds Y](../topics/hooks.md#hook-contrast-looks-sounds) · sources R1, L08, SP, KH

## Start narrow, expand in layers (80/20)
<a id="narrow-then-layers"></a>

Be great at one thing first, then add adjacent topics; 80% core, 20% other interests.

**Looks like:** Most reels sit on one pillar with one look. Every fifth one stacks a side interest (gym plus tech: 'the apps I track my lifts with'). The account reads as one clear thing.

**Good at:** quality followers; clear positioning; trust

**Weak at:** slower early reach; can feel restrictive

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, yt-long · niches all · goals follows, trust · effort low

**How:** Tag each idea core or side and keep the ratio. No production change.

**Backed by:** [Start narrow, expand in layers](../topics/brand.md#brand-start-narrow-layers), [80/20 interest stacking](../topics/brand.md#brand-interest-stacking), [Small right audience beats big wrong one](../topics/brand.md#brand-follower-quality), [Widen the audience one layer higher](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-high-tam-one-layer-up), [Pause-and-play breakdown of a reel](../topics/ideas.md#l10-pause-and-play-breakdown) · sources L05, L08

## Wide on top of funnel, narrow lower down
<a id="split-by-funnel"></a>

Reach posts go wide; teaching and selling posts go narrow. Briar splits them this way.

**Looks like:** A wide relatable reel brings strangers in. A narrow 'blow their mind' breakdown for the core audience follows. Each post knows its job.

**Good at:** balances reach and quality; clear goals per post; each post has one job

**Weak at:** needs planning across posts; wide posts can still attract ghosts

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, story · niches all · goals reach, trust, sales · effort medium

**How:** Label each idea TOFU, MOFU or BOFU before scripting.

**Backed by:** [Content funnel: top, middle, bottom](../topics/growth.md#growth-content-funnel), [Weekly mix 4 : 2 : 1](../topics/growth.md#growth-weekly-4-2-1), [Widen the audience one layer higher](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-high-tam-one-layer-up), [Closer to the dollars, more money](../topics/business.md#biz-closer-to-dollars), [Follow up with "not now" people](../topics/business.md#biz-follow-up-not-now) · sources L08, L07

## Mixing
Rahul's sample shows both: universal tricks got the most reach, niche builds the best like rates. Interest stacking widens without abandoning the core.

## Rule of thumb
Reach: one layer up. Loyal engagement: hyper-specific. Long-term brand: narrow then layers. A mixed weekly plan: split by funnel.
